notes: Registration input, not a run input: every trade (trade_id, ticker, created_time, yes_price, count, taker_side) of the four index series from the kalshi_history pack (ADR-0239), each market asked of the archive that owns each period of its life. Gate G0.2 uses it for volume by strike and distance from spot; Stage 4 uses taker_side to estimate how often a resting maker quote would have been hit. Pulled per market, so size it from the markets census first. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source kalshi-history-trades-index --catalog-source kalshi-history-trades-index --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.kalshi_history:KalshiHistoryConnector --config @configs/source-kalshi-history-trades-index.json --activate --root <store root>; acquire --stream trades --mode backfill.
